'''2016 European Championship Day 2 Chris Menzel LS Plead My Case To The Senate''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Chris Menzel]] at [[2016 European Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Chris Menzel]]
* '''Event:''' [[2016 European Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]

* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
